popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Perseid stemma — Sthenelus son of Perseus as father of Eurystheus, the Mycenaean king who sets Heracles' labours.

popCulture.title: Eurystheus
popCulture.description: King of Mycenae who imposed the Twelve Labours — son of Sthenelus the Perseid, the father whose premature birth Hera engineers against Heracles.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book XIX — Agamemnon recalls Zeus' deception over Eurystheus' birth: Sthenelus' house gains the sceptre that should have been Heracles'.

popCulture.title: Sthenelus
popCulture.description: Perseid king of Mycenae — father of Eurystheus, distinct from Capaneus' son who fights among the Epigoni.
